question: Can a typed evidence comparator distinguish incompatible claims on one retained count domain from count differences caused by scope or snapshot changes?
scope: Replay-verified EONET bundles, USGS seismic packets, NWS receipts; exact count claims only; no causal, safety, or real-world truth inference.
primary_endpoint: Exact expected classification on designed synthetic cases; zero false logical-conflict labels across mismatched domains; complete agreement with finite integer predicate oracle.
baseline: Unequal available counts imply contradiction (deliberately naive diagnostic, not a competitive method).
acceptance: Every deterministic assertion passes; no regression in available local suite; all packet changes rejected by replay. No claim of independent empirical scientific validation.
stop_rule: One bounded deterministic suite, no live source retrieval or production writes; stop on mismatch.
